name: Mister Fantasy Advisor
install: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3.12-venv && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Servidor estatico del dashboard/PWA (public/). Abrir http://127.0.0.1:8080/. Regenerar datos con '.venv/bin/python src/data_engine.py' (usa secrets MISTER_* para datos live; si no, cae a mock/seed). Tests: '.venv/bin/python scripts/test_*.py'.
